decisions: Both Radio Browser fetch paths use redirect:error, preserving one configured HTTPS provider origin.

Accepted provider UUIDs are canonicalized to lowercase before rendering and signing.
The changed shared player bundle uses ui://dial/radio-v3.html for open_radio; country-v1 remains its existing resource identity because that delivered script did not change during this repair.
npm start scopes Node IPv4-first and disabled family autoselection flags to this process.
